prompt: Apply Tashtit's standard GitHub repository settings and the attached branch protection ruleset to this repository.
setup: The requester has admin permission and confirms the target owner/repo and default branch.
The repository currently allows all three merge methods, has an empty wiki, and runs a 'ci' status check reported by a known GitHub App integration id.
A reviewed ruleset definition targeting the default branch is provided.
expected: Current settings and existing rulesets are read before any change and the intended from/to values are summarized for confirmation.
Squash merging is enabled with PR_TITLE and COMMIT_MESSAGES while merge commits and rebase merging are disabled, and auto-merge, delete-branch-on-merge, and allow-update-branch are enabled.
The empty wiki and unused projects feature are disabled, and the ruleset is created or updated with squash-only allowed merge methods and only status checks that actually run.
Changes are verified by re-reading settings and the ruleset, and each change is reported from-value to to-value with rollback steps.
must_not: Invent a default branch, required check context, integration id, reviewer, or ruleset name.
Disable every merge method or claim a change was applied without re-reading it.
